'''2002 World Championship Angelo Consoli DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Angelo Consoli]] posted on DeckTech after winning the [[2002 World Championship]].<ref name="skilton-26297">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/26297/ DeckTech post 26297], Stephen Skilton Decktech Archives (Angelo "GravShadow" Consoli, 19 November 2002)</ref>

== Strategy ==

[[Bastian Winkelhaus]] invented the decktype. Consoli and Winkelhaus both played it at Worlds; Winkelhaus's 60 differed (Trample, Fanfare, Mournful Roar, Trooper Sabacc; no Force Field, one fewer card on Fear Is My Ally, no The Phantom Menace, no Darth Sidious).<ref name="skilton-26297" /> The third starting Effect is matchup-dependent: [[Wipe Them Out, All Of Them]] against [[Watch Your Step]], [[Colo Claw Fish]] against lightsaber combat, [[No Escape]] against [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]. Search [[Rendili]] before activating; first-turn flip is [[Watto]] plus [[Reegesk (V) (Virtual Set 3)|Reegesk (V)]]. [[We Must Accelerate Our Plans]] deploys [[Blockade Flagship: Bridge]]. Martin Falke supplied the Reegesk and Force Field tech.
